text:
nora.b: hi all, nora here (joined infra today). i'm blocked on GCP eu access — switching to project `redwood-eu-eval-01` gives 403. also tried to assume an AWS role for s3 logs and got AccessDenied. what are the minimum roles i should ask for to: view project, create a service account, and assume read-only roles in aws? who do i ping for billing link?
kevin.cloud: welcome! minimal GCP: roles/browser to view, roles/iam.serviceAccountUser to impersonate SAs, and roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin only if you must create SAs (we usually create them for new hires). For AWS you need sts:AssumeRole + a role in the target account that trusts our SSO principal.
ana.security: (sic) prefer not to grant iam.admin org-wide. Request temporary admin for SA creation or ask cloud-admin to create the SA and bind you as serviceAccountUser. For AWS, we scope assume roles to specific ARNs and limit session duration.
ora.b: thanks. can someone create `nora-eu-test-sa` with compute.viewer + serviceAccountUser for me? and an aws role `rdw-onboard-nora` with s3:ListBucket/s3:GetObject for 4h?
devops: i can do both. @fin-bot please link project redwood-eu-eval-01 to EU billing (cost center: infra-onboard) with soft cap $100/mo.
fin-bot: Billing request received for project redwood-eu-eval-01. Confirmation pending finance approval. Budget alerts set at 80% once linked.
kevin.cloud: SA created and bound to nora.b as serviceAccountUser. AWS role `arn:aws:iam::333222111000:role/rdw-onboard-nora` created, trust set to our SSO. Use: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::333222111000:role/rdw-onboard-nora --role-session-name nora-onboard --duration-seconds 14400`.
nora.b: both worked, i can deploy test container and list bucket contents. thx! quick q: any EU region GPU quota caveats?
ana.security: quotas are per-account/per-region. file a quota request if you need >2 GPUs, or use preemptible for short tests. Also ensure MFA enabled for billing ops.
nora.b: MFA already set. really appreciate the quick help! :smile:
